content: {"like":["Enjoys anime with strong female leads and dark themes, especially Sailor Moon S’s Apocalypse arc","Values high-quality English dubs with well-known voice actors like Wendy Lee and Michelle Ruff","Prefers anime releases that include bonus content such as exclusive coins or art booklets","Appreciates series that expand on original storylines, like Little Busters EX’s new heroine routes","Likes themed DVD collections that gather related episodes, e.g., My Little Pony Crystal Empire set"],"dislike":["Dislikes anime where main character is portrayed as irredeemably evil, such as Fushigi Yugi Eikoden","Rejects releases with poor packaging or missing bonus features, e.g., Sentai Filmworks’ Clannad box","Disapproves of anime dubs with questionable voice casting or unclear lines, like Little Busters EX’s English dub","Criticizes releases that cut opening songs or episode previews, such as Pioneer’s Sailor Moon S sets","Avoids themed DVDs that omit key episodes or misalign with the theme, e.g., My Little Pony Royal Pony Wedding"]}
